functions.notes: Returns &mgr->slots[i] for first free slot, else NULL. Leaf, no push. Codegen detail: free-check walks a cursor (r3 += 0xc) reading [r3+4], while the returned address is computed fresh as mgr+4 + 0xc*i (mul) — the mul vs cursor split may need trial and error.

risks: Existing header include/overlay_01_021FB4C0.h declares ov01_021FB4F4/ov01_021FB514 with `u32 a0` and is included by already-matched src/field_take_photo.c and src/unk_02055BF0.c (callers pass fieldSystem->unk4->unk1c which is u32 in include/field_system.h). Per the IPA shared-header hazard, do NOT change these to pointer params — keep u32 and cast to the struct pointer inside the function bodies.
ov01_021FB554 is a `ldr r3,=...; bx r3` tail-call thunk: arg types of thunk and ov01_021FB584 must match exactly.
Byte-clear loop in ov01_021FB55C: decrement-and-branch-at-bottom shape; `do {...} while (--n);` vs `while (n != 0)` produce different bytes — may need iteration.
ov01_021FB5B4 mixes cursor-walk (r3 += 0xc) for the test with mul-computed (&mgr->slots[i]) for the return value — exact C loop form may need trial and error.

Five functions (ov01_021FB55C/584/594/5B0/5B4) are absent from .public — they must be static; three have addresses taken (584 via thunk, 594 as GFIntrCB, 5B0 as default cb); forward declarations needed since 4C0 calls 55C before its definition.
No .rodata/.data/.bss in this file — only literal pools.
notes: Self-contained HBlank-callback multiplexer for overlay 1: a 0x1c manager (flag + 2 slots) allocated by ov01_021FB4C0; ov01_021FB4F4/514 register/unregister ov01_021FB594 as the global HBlank GFIntrCB; ov01_021FB530 claims a slot with (cb, arg) and ov01_021FB554 releases it. Function order in C must follow asm order: 4C0, 4D4, 4F4, 514, 530, 554, 55C, 584, 594, 5B0, 5B4. New public header should add ov01_021FB4C0 (returns ptr), ov01_021FB4D4, ov01_021FB530, ov01_021FB554 to the existing include/overlay_01_021FB4C0.h without touching the two existing u32 prototypes. asm callers: asm/overlay_01_021E5900.s (4C0/4F4/4D4), asm/overlay_01_021FB5D4.s and asm/overlay_01_021EFB38.s (530/554), overlays 114/117/119/120 (4F4/514).
